messages:
support-joe: Seeing a burst of 403s on the dashboard when customers switch orgs/projects after an IdP session refresh. Started ~08:20 UTC. Screenshot attached in ticket #T-4219.

support-joe: Error from console: `403 Permission denied: missing role for project` but roles look fine in the API. Repro steps I used:
1) Login via Okta SSO in Chrome
2) Open dashboard, switch org -> 403
3) Refresh page -> sometimes works after re-login

alex: Thanks Joe. Any correlation with recent IdP config change or token lifetime?

support-joe: Not on our side. Customer says IdP pushed a session rekey around same time. We see auth headers still present, token introspection says active, but console returns 403.

eng-oncall-bot: New alert group created: auth-service:token-validation-failures spike (10m avg)

tanvi: I dug into gateway logs. When the IdP forces a session rotation it issues a new session cookie. Browser keeps old access token in local storage for a bit. Requests hit the API with the old token and the token introspection endpoint returns active -> but our RBAC cache lookup uses the session ID from the cookie to map to role bindings. If session concurrency limit is 1, IdP invalidates old session id immediately. Introspection still shows token active for ~30s due to clock skew in introspection caches, so we get a mismatch: token valid but session -> role mapping gone -> 403.

maria: @tanvi good catch. Okta team forwarded that they enabled strict concurrent session limit for orgs this week to enforce SSO policy. That would revoke old sessions on a new login.

support-joe: So customers logging in from multiple devices or if they re-auth during SSO push will hit this. Any quick mitigation?

tanvi: Short-term workaround: have console fallback to re-fetch roles using the access token if session lookup fails, and trigger a silent token refresh flow. Quick patch: if session-id lookup returns null, call `/auth/v1/roles?token=<access>` and accept returned role set for 403->200 transition for existing requests. I'll open a patch PR.

alex: For now, escalate to account team and suggest users "Sign out of other sessions" or re-login in same browser. Also add a KB note about concurrent session limits and 403s.

maria: I'll ask IdP ops to consider relaxing concurrency for affected orgs while we deploy fallback. Also adding a header that indicates session revocation so we can detect this more reliably: `X-IdP-Session-Revoked: true` in introspection response.

support-joe: Documenting repro for support article: include steps, the console network trace showing `cookie: session_id=abcd1234` then `cookie` changing to `session_id=efgh5678` and a 403 on requests where session_id != introspected_session_id.

tanvi: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-service/pull/482 (WIP). Patch will: 1) try role-by-token fallback, 2) add metric `rbac.session_miss->role_lookup_by_token`, 3) short-circuit noisy 403s with `Retry-After: 3` header so clients can do a silent refresh.

idp-ops-bot: Okta incident opened: INC-998 (session concurrency policy change). Notified impacted org admins.

alex: Good. Next actions: tanvi deploy hotfix to staging today, run e2e with Okta concurrency set to 1, maria follow up with IdP to roll back for affected customers, support-joe prepare KB and customer note. I'll tag PM/CS for comms. :thumbsup:

support-joe: Thanks all — logging this in ticket and notifying customer contact. Will update thread after deploy/patch verified. :wave:
